name: Run 400 Muse claim-verifier baseline
articleTitle: Meta’s Muse AI assistant faces zero-day breach that lets apps take full control
purpose: Golden regression fixture for the Phase 0 claim-verifier investigation. It records the claims that exposed the current provenance/matching failure without changing verifier behavior.

claims.claim: The flaw lets any app or terminal command acquire the token that authenticates users to their Muse account.
claims.support: The zero-day allows any app or terminal command to gain access to the token that authenticates users to their Muse account.

claims.claim: One key setting is the endpoint used for transcription.
claims.support: It allows processes to change the endpoint where transcription occurs.

claims.claim: Normally the endpoint points to a Meta-operated server.
claims.support: Normally, it’s a server address operated by Meta.

claims.claim: The vulnerability enables a process to redirect this endpoint to an attacker’s server, effectively hijacking the transcription flow.
claims.support: Attackers can exploit this flaw by changing the location to their own endpoint.

claims.claim: Amazon, on Sunday, began blocking Muse from its site.
claims.support: Further raising questions, Amazon on Sunday began blocking Muse from its site.

claims.claim: Muse is designed to book appointments, fill forms, handle customer service, make purchases, generate images, create documents, and integrate with popular apps.
claims.support: The assistant books appointments, fills out forms and handles customer service; it can make purchases, generate images, create documents, and connect with apps and services.

claims.claim: It can also work with a user’s WhatsApp, email, calendar, and social media accounts.
claims.support: The macOS app also works with a user’s WhatsApp, email, calendar, and social media accounts.

claims.claim: Meta’s claim that Muse is ‘built from the ground up for privacy and security’ is contradicted by a flaw that permits complete local control of the agent.
claims.support: Meta promoted Muse as built from the ground up for privacy and security; the zero-day gives locally run apps and terminal commands complete control of the agent.

example.wrongSelectedEvidence: It’s likely Meta intended for apps working with Muse to control UI settings.

phase0PassCriteria: Fixture preserves the Run 400 article/claim failure pattern.
Each supported claim has an explicit sourceId and immutable passageId.
The fixture can be used as a regression target without changing production verifier thresholds.
Current verifier behavior is measured before Phase 1 changes.
